scientific_integrity: Algebraic theorem with complete scalar proof; exact rational witness; independent audit not performed. No claim of external certification, or of novelty for the generic quartic normal form.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two stage-cost periods, fixed bilinear state-input payment, single myopic unconstrained follower, zero reference and scalar unconstrained real incentive.
The leader objective does not impose Schur stability; an unstable global optimum over a short horizon is not recommended for continued use.
Prior literature on dynamic contracts and quartic bifurcations may contain equivalent observations; priority independently unconfirmed.
title: A sharp finite-horizon incentive switch between stable and unstable feedback
